Welcome to Turning Point

Located in Tilda Neora, Turning Point is a hotel built around three simple promises: spotless rooms, honest prices and warm, attentive service. Whether you are here for business, a family function or a night on the road, you will find a comfortable place to rest.

Our Cleanliness Promise

Cleanliness is the first thing guests notice, so it is the first thing we check.

  • ✓ Fresh, laundered bed linen and towels for every guest
  • ✓ Bathrooms scrubbed and sanitised daily
  • ✓ High-touch surfaces disinfected between stays
  • ✓ Daily housekeeping and regular pest control
  • ✓ Purified drinking water in every room
